utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Gus, are you bringing anything to Cleo's repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I sure am! I'm actually the one organizing it, so I'll be there with my truck full of tools. Starting at the Smiths' fence first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, no kidding! I didn't realize you were the one behind it—I was just going to dig out my old toolbox for Cleo. Consider me there with bells on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? They're fixing old appliances for free, and there's even a workshop afterwards!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Tess, it's been moved to Sunday at the community center—still from 10 to 4, and I'm helping organize it. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Sunday works even better for me! I'll definitely be there, and I'll bring my old toaster that's been acting up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Maybe I can ask Leo for an extra flyer if you need one, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be great, Uli! Every flyer helps spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll talk to Leo then and see if he has any extras.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I've got a list started—let me check who's bringing tools so we don't end up with three hammers and no screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing! I'm bringing my power drill and socket set, so check those off your list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, Jules—I've got you down for the drill and sockets. Now, any chance you've got a spare extension cord we could borrow? I'm tallying needs to make sure we're all set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mina, sorry I'm late again. What's the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So what exactly needs to be repaired? I want to know what I'm getting into before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Well, folks are bringing things like broken lamps and blenders—I think Vik's got a blender that needs fixing. It's at the community center, so we'll probably just help people with whatever they bring.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hana is checking the shed for the repair drive right now—once she confirms, we can match up everything everyone's bringing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I hope she finds some of my old things in there—I'm sure I left at least a few items that could use fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm sure she'll let us know soon—she's always thorough. Once we have the list, we can see if your old things need a spot on the repair table.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Bo, I hear the repair drive starts at 9 sharp. I've got my old toaster ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: 9 sharp? I thought it was 10. I'll have to double-check—I keep losing track of the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Better check with Pia, Bo. She’s the one who keeps everything straight around here.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'll head to the shed now to double-check on the repair drive and pick up those extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh great, Hana! I'm glad you're on top of that. I've got my old blender ready to bring—see you there!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Perfect, Ira! I'll be in and out of the shed in just a few minutes—let me verify the repair drive and grab those cords.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've got the community center locked in for Saturday at 10 AM, and Jules volunteered their tools. Are you planning to come?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, I'm bringing my drill and level.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll add that to my list. Can I count on you to help set up at 9:30?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Quinn, so it's just drop-in for small appliances all day then?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's right, Rey! Drop-in any time, but mornings are best for the full crew. Also, don't forget to bring any extra tools you've got — we're trying to avoid five hammers and no wrenches!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, I'll bring my multimeter and a few screwdrivers in the morning then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Sam, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4! I'm bringing my old blender.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, a blender sounds like a fun challenge! I'll make sure we have small tools for appliances too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, and I heard Marlon's bringing his old toaster, so there should be plenty of small appliances to tinker with!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I think I heard something about that... Is it this Saturday? I might have an old hammer somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, Noah—are we sure about Saturday? I've seen dates come and go before, so I need someone to tell me straight if this thing is actually happening.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? Saturday? I mean, I think I saw a flyer... maybe Tuesday? Honestly, I'm not sure—I lose track of these things.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rey, I'm organizing a repair drive for the community center. Got any spare parts or tools you could donate?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don't have many tools, but I can bring my old blender for repair.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, a blender is perfect! We're collecting all sorts of things to fix up and repurpose.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing Bo—I'll text Opal right now and see if you're on the list. You know I'll be there wrench in hand either way!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, thanks Jules, that'd be great—I really should make up my mind soon, I know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No rush, Bo—just let me know what you decide, and I'll save you a spot on my tool station if you want to work on something together!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I might have a broken chair. Not sure if it's worth bringing, but I could use a hand looking at it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli! Bring it by on Saturday; our volunteers are great at fixing furniture. The drive starts at 10 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rosa. I'll try to bring it. Maybe it's not too far gone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: See you tomorrow morning, then—I'll have the list and a fresh pot of coffee.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You bet, Faye! I'll bring my walking shoes and a notepad—we'll knock this out before lunch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, Quinn—I'll have the coffee ready and the schedule mapped out so we can hit the ground running.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I want to make sure we have a full list of who's bringing what — anyone have a screwdriver set or wire strippers?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can check on the repair drive and extension cords when I head to the shed—let me confirm those first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks Hana! And when you check, could you also look for an extra voltage tester? I want to make sure we don't miss any electrical items.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm glad everyone's on board for the drive—I'll bring my toolbox this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Nell! Your toolbox will be a huge help—I'll grab my soldering iron and see you there!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, that soldering iron will be a lifesaver for some of the finer fixes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I almost forgot about that. Are you bringing anything to fix?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, I was thinking of bringing my old toaster, but honestly, I'm more excited about the workshop after—I've been wanting to learn how to fix things myself!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, a workshop! That sounds like a great idea. I keep meaning to learn how to fix my own stuff—maybe I'll actually remember to show up this time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Leo! I'll note you're bringing hammers and saws to Gus's garage at 8. Thanks for being so organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Glad to help. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, I've got you down. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Opal, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm bringing my old blender and Marlon's bringing a toaster—it's at the community center from 10 to 4!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I've got the full schedule mapped out. Jules is lending a power drill and socket set, and I'm coordinating pickup times so everything runs smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's great, Opal! I also heard Hana's heading to the shed now to check on the repair drive setup—should be quick.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Kira, I think we're in good shape for the drive—Mina's got her tools ready, and I've been checking in with everyone on the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: But is it actually happening this time, Sam? I've heard that before.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, it's definitely happening. I've confirmed the site, the volunteers, and the supply list—we're all set for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Gus, I hope you've got a solid schedule for this repair drive. I like to know what's happening and when.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Eli! I've got the whole schedule mapped out: we're starting at the Smiths' fence at 9 AM, then moving to the Martins' porch at 11, with a lunch break and workshop at 1.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that sounds well-organized. And the workshop starts right after the lunch break at 1 PM, correct?
